_doc: Catalog keys where upstream uses "Kiro" as the agent's name. scripts/rewrite_strings.py replaces that name with ASSISTANT_NAME (devteam.conf) in every language's upstream text, so upstream translation fixes still arrive. Each key records the English it was checked against: if upstream rewords one, prepare.sh fails and names it. A language whose translation omits the name is left as upstream wrote it.
